_metadata.description: N-body validation of Gadget-4 EU simulation. Null test (no SELFGRAVITY) + Production (full TreePM).

null_test.description: Null test run with SELFGRAVITY disabled. P(k) should be flat (no structure). CDM drain IS active.

drain_validation.description: Null test and Production must have identical drain because drain is background-level mass rescaling, decoupled from gravity.

suppression_ratio.description: S(k,z) = P_EU(k,z) / P_LCDM(k,z). LCDM computed via CLASS + HMCode with identical cosmological parameters.

growth_factor.description: D(z) extracted from P(k_ref, z) in linear regime. Compared with ODE solution.
